contact.evidence_quote: Konstantin Preslavsky University of Shumen Hosts Its Second International Erasmus+ Blended Intensive Programme ... Konstantin Preslavsky University of Shumen successfully launched “The Resilient Educator: Holistic Approaches for Preventing Burnout”, bringing together students and academic staff from 10 partner universities across Europe. Organised by the Faculty of Education at Shumen University, this international Blended Intensive Programme (BIP) under Erasmus+ explores holistic approaches to supporting educators’ well-being and preventing burnout.
